intro: Explore Benidorm at your own pace. Save your plans, favourites and holiday spending on your device.

areas.name: Levante Beach
areas.description: Popular eastern beach with a long promenade, cafes and a lively atmosphere.

areas.name: Poniente Beach
areas.description: Wide western beach and promenade, often a quieter choice for a stroll.

areas.name: Old Town
areas.description: Winding streets, shops and traditional places to eat between the two main beaches.

areas.name: Balcón del Mediterráneo
areas.description: Scenic viewpoint between Levante and Poniente beaches.

areas.name: La Cala / Finestrat
areas.description: Nearby coastal area worth exploring for a change of scenery.

attractions.name: Benidorm Old Town
attractions.description: Explore the streets, viewpoints and local shops.

attractions.name: Parque de Elche
attractions.description: Seafront park near the Old Town and Poniente.

attractions.name: Serra Gelada Natural Park
attractions.description: Coastal landscape and walking routes; check trail conditions and difficulty.

attractions.name: Terra Mítica
attractions.description: Theme park; check current operating dates and tickets online.

attractions.name: Aqualandia
attractions.description: Water park; check seasonal opening before visiting.

attractions.name: Mundomar
attractions.description: Wildlife attraction; check current visitor information online.

transport.name: Walking
transport.description: Promenades and central areas are walkable; allow for hills around the Old Town.

transport.name: Local buses
transport.description: Check current routes, fares and timetables with the local operator.

transport.name: Tram
transport.description: TRAM d’Alacant serves the wider Costa Blanca; check the official timetable.

transport.name: Airport transfers
transport.description: Compare transfer options from Alicante–Elche Airport before travel.

useful.name: Emergency services
useful.description: Call 112 in an emergency in Spain.

useful.name: Healthcare
useful.description: Bring appropriate travel insurance and any relevant healthcare documents.

useful.name: Travel documents
useful.description: Check current entry and passport requirements before departure.

useful.name: Live weather and opening hours
useful.description: Require internet access; verify locally before setting out.

beaches.name: Levante Beach
beaches.description: Lively sandy beach with a busy promenade, places to eat and water activities; look for beach safety flags.

beaches.name: Poniente Beach
beaches.description: Long sandy beach with a broad promenade, attractive for walks and relaxed beach days.

beaches.name: Mal Pas Beach
beaches.description: Small cove by the Old Town and harbour; can be busy during peak season.

beaches.name: Cala Tío Ximo
beaches.description: Small rocky cove beyond Levante, suited to a quieter stop; check access and sea conditions.

beaches.name: La Cala de Finestrat
beaches.description: Sheltered sandy bay just outside Benidorm with restaurants and a promenade.

markets.name: Benidorm outdoor markets
markets.description: Browse clothes, gifts and everyday items. Market days, locations and opening hours can change; check locally before visiting.

markets.name: Old Town shopping streets
markets.description: Explore smaller shops, cafés and local businesses around the historic centre.

markets.name: Local produce and food shopping
markets.description: Look for fresh food shops and municipal markets; check current opening hours and holiday closures.

nightlife.name: Levante entertainment area
nightlife.description: A lively area for bars, live music and evening entertainment. Check venue schedules and accessibility.

nightlife.name: Old Town evenings
nightlife.description: Restaurants, tapas bars and smaller venues offer an alternative to the busiest nightlife streets.

nightlife.name: Seafront sunset stroll
nightlife.description: Walk the Levante or Poniente promenades for a relaxed evening; be mindful of personal belongings.

nightlife.name: Shows and cabaret
nightlife.description: Entertainment programmes vary by season; confirm times, prices and age restrictions with venues.

family.name: Aqualandia
family.description: Seasonal water park with slides and pools; check opening dates, height rules and tickets.

family.name: Terra Mítica
family.description: Theme park with rides and shows; confirm seasonal schedule and ride restrictions.

family.name: Mundomar
family.description: Wildlife park with exhibits and activities; check the official visitor information.

family.name: Beach and promenade day
family.description: Easy-going family day at Poniente or Levante; use shade, sun protection and beach flags.

family.name: Serra Gelada nature outing
family.description: Enjoy coastal scenery on a suitable trail; choose routes based on weather, ability and footwear.

dining.name: Old Town tapas streets
dining.description: Explore the narrow streets around Calle Santo Domingo for tapas bars and traditional Spanish dishes. Check menus and prices before ordering.

dining.name: Levante promenade cafés
dining.description: Seafront cafés and casual dining with views across Levante Beach.

dining.name: Poniente promenade restaurants
dining.description: Restaurants and cafés along the western promenade, suited to a relaxed meal or coffee.

dining.name: La Cala de Finestrat
dining.description: Nearby coastal dining area with cafés and restaurants around the beach.

daytrips.name: Altea
daytrips.description: Whitewashed Old Town, church square and sea views. Accessible by local transport; check current TRAM and bus connections.

daytrips.name: Guadalest
daytrips.description: Mountain village known for its castle views and reservoir. Check bus or organised excursion availability before travelling.

daytrips.name: Villajoyosa (La Vila Joiosa)
daytrips.description: Colourful waterfront houses, beaches and chocolate heritage. Check current TRAM services and attraction opening times.

daytrips.name: Calpe
daytrips.description: Coastal town with beaches and the prominent Peñón de Ifach rock. Check transport and walking conditions.
